title: GSBF: Gaussian Splatting for Environment-Aware Beamforming
abstract: arXiv:2608.05896v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Beamforming plays a key role in multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) communication systems. However, conventional beamforming design normally requires accurate instantaneous channel state information (CSI) and iterative optimization, which incur substantial pilot overhead and computational complexity. Recognizing that radio propagation is intrinsically governed by the physical geometry, we develop a 3D Gaussian splatting for environment-aware beamforming (GSBF) pipeline based on multi-modal data, which characterizes the environment through a persistent 3D Gaussian representation. Specifically, GSBF models the environmental scattering response with reciprocity-preserving bidirectional spherical Gaussian (Bi-SG) kernels and performs two-sided electromagnetic rasterization to render an angular propagator map. translated_title: GSBF：面向环境感知波束赋形的高斯溅射技术
translated_abstract: 波束赋形在多输入多输出（MIMO）通信系统中扮演着关键角色。然而，传统的波束赋形设计通常需要精确的瞬时信道状态信息（CSI）和迭代优化，这带来了大量的导频开销和计算复杂度。鉴于无线电传播本质上受物理几何结构控制，我们基于多模态数据开发了一种用于环境感知波束赋形的3D高斯溅射（GSBF）流程，该流程通过持久的3D高斯表示来表征环境。具体来说，GSBF使用具有互易性保持的双向球面高斯（Bi-SG）核来建模环境散射响应，并执行双侧电磁光栅化以渲染角度传播图。随后，渲染的图通过过完备阵列流形字典进行聚合，并投影到恒模波束上。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于3D高斯溅射的环境感知波束赋形方法，通过双向球面高斯核建模环境散射并渲染角度传播图，避免了传统方法对精确CSI和迭代优化的依赖，显著降低了导频开销和计算复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a 3D Gaussian splatting-based environment-aware beamforming method that models environmental scattering with bidirectional spherical Gaussian kernels and renders angular propagator maps, eliminating the need for precise CSI and iterative optimization to reduce pilot overhead and computational complexity.
